# PDF Studio

Every tool you need to work with PDFs, in one place, merge, split, compress, convert, edit, sign and protect, all privately in your browser.

38 tools. Each name opens the tool on gigai.tools, where its page explains how to use it step by step.

| Tool | What it does | Input | Output | Runs |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [Add Page Numbers to PDF](https://gigai.tools/document-page-number) | Drop a PDF and stamp clean, consistent page numbers on every page: choose the corner, a bare number or a 'Page X of Y' label, the starting number, the font size and the margin, and optionally skip a cover page. The numbers are real, selectable vector text drawn on top of your document, and everything runs 100% in your browser. Your file is never uploaded. | PDF | PDF | Browser |
| [Compress PDF](https://gigai.tools/compress-pdf) | Make heavy PDFs email-friendly. Choose Low, Medium or High compression, watch the before-and-after sizes update, and download a lighter file, all processed on your device, nothing uploaded. | PDF | PDF | Browser |
| [Crop PDF](https://gigai.tools/crop-pdf) | Cut the dead space off every page at once. | PDF | PDF | Browser |
| [Delete PDF Pages](https://gigai.tools/delete-pdf-pages) | See every page as a thumbnail, tick the ones you don't want, and delete them for good. The pages you keep are rebuilt into one clean PDF: previewed on screen, never uploaded, with no watermark. | PDF | PDF | Browser |
| [Document Comparer](https://gigai.tools/document-comparer) | Drop two versions of a contract, brief, README or report and instantly see every difference. The tool extracts the text from each PDF, Word, RTF, TXT or Markdown file right in your browser and paints a clean redline (removals struck in red, additions in green) with a live change count and line- or word-level granularity. No upload, no account, nothing stored. | PDF, DOCX, DOC, RTF, TXT, MD | Diff, TXT | Browser |

## Where the backend comes in

- **PDF to Excel**: Optional OCR repair sends the PDF to the backend, after a notice. Everything else stays in the browser.
- **PDF to Word**: Converts in the browser. A self-hosted site whose backend has LibreOffice can turn on server conversion (NEXT_PUBLIC_SERVER_CONVERT); gigai.tools does not.
- **Word to PDF**: Converts in the browser. A self-hosted site whose backend has LibreOffice can turn on server conversion (NEXT_PUBLIC_SERVER_CONVERT); gigai.tools does not.
